description: Deterministic compliance edits. Phase 4 of the pipeline checks drafted CPT code combinations against ptp_edits (NCCI procedure-to-procedure bundling) and per-code unit counts against mue_limits (Medically Unlikely Edits). This is an illustrative subset for demonstrating the pattern -- not the full, quarterly-updated CMS NCCI/MUE tables, which would be loaded from licensed CMS data files in production.

ptp_edits.rationale: A diagnostic laparoscopy converted to an open procedure in the same session is bundled into the definitive procedure and is never separately billable, regardless of modifier.
Diagnostic laparoscopy is bundled into the definitive laparoscopic procedure performed in the same session.

ptp_edits.column2_desc: Simple repair of superficial wounds, 2.5 cm or less
ptp_edits.rationale: Simple closure of the excision site is included in the excision code unless a distinct, separately identifiable repair is documented -- modifier 59 may apply if clinically supported.

ptp_edits.column1_desc: Insertion of non-tunneled centrally inserted central venous catheter
ptp_edits.column2_desc: Ultrasound guidance for vascular access, with permanent image and report
ptp_edits.rationale: Ultrasound guidance is separately billable only when permanent images and a written report documenting guidance are produced; absent that documentation it is bundled into the line placement.

mue_limits.description: Arthrocentesis, aspiration and/or injection, major joint (e.g. knee)
Insertion of non-tunneled centrally inserted central venous catheter
